title: Open-Meteo ERA5 archive — Ouarzazate, 7–17 April, 2015–2025
claims: For Ouarzazate on 7–17 April in 2015–2025 there are 121 daily records: daily maximum 15.0–33.1 °C (median 26.8 °C), daily minimum 2.6–16.5 °C (median 10.0 °C), 4 days with at least 1 mm precipitation and 4 days with at least 5 mm.
The grid is Ouarzazate town, not the Sahara bivouac or the stage route south of M'Hamid.

verification.note: Daily values retrieved and filtered to 7–17 April; medians and wet-day counts calculated locally.
